$comment: Machine-readable roll-up of every load-bearing claim FINALTab makes, each tied to how it was
measured. If a claim is not in this file, it is not backed. If a claim is in this file with
state UNPROVEN or BLOCKED, the project says so publicly rather than implying otherwise.
commitNote: Measured against commit 84e5397 PLUS an uncommitted working tree (43 modified tracked files, 31 untracked at the time of the run). Not a clean-checkout result: re-running these commands on a fresh clone of 84e5397 produces the pre-fix numbers, not these.

labels.LIVE_PROVEN: A real external system was contacted and the response is recorded.
labels.FIXTURE_PROVEN: Exercised only against local fixtures or mocked module boundaries.
labels.LIVE_EXERCISED_FAILED: A real external call was made and returned a real failure. The surface is proven; the success is not.
labels.BLOCKED: Cannot be proven without an action outside autonomous scope.
labels.UNPROVEN: Code exists, no evidence either way.
labels.NOT_APPLIED: Written but never installed or run anywhere.

claims.claim: 200 tests pass and 1 is skipped
claims.method: pnpm vitest per package; cd contracts && npx hardhat test
claims.caveat: The single skip needs a live GROQ_API_KEY. No coverage percentage is claimed anywhere, because no coverage run has been performed.

claims.claim: The settlement contract is deployed on Base Sepolia
claims.method: eth_getCode against https://sepolia.base.org, re-run 2026-08-10, returned 4520 hex chars = 2259 bytes
claims.caveat: Source is NOT verified on Basescan. This is why the settle route passes the ABI inline instead of relying on a published one.

claims.claim: Atomicity, replay protection, nonce binding, expiry, and selector correctness hold
claims.value: 11 Hardhat tests including 4 selector tests added after a latent signature mismatch was found
claims.caveat: Proven on a local Hardhat chain against a mock USDC. Never exercised against real USDC on a public chain.

claims.claim: A real KeeperHub execution landed a chain-verified receipt
claims.method: scripts/first-flight.mjs, receipt independently confirmed on chain rather than trusting the status field
claims.corroboration: A second independent execution, 41j3clx0b5xkv8vfv97hl / 0x98920aeb..., also reached VERIFIED_SETTLED. Per-surface detail in keeperhub-surfaces.json.

claims.claim: executeSettlement moves USDC on a public chain
claims.blocker: Demo accounts hold zero Base Sepolia USDC and the KeeperHub relayer 0x7ae891ec51990684682a084381e97b59d787652b holds zero native BASE. KeeperHub sponsors transfers, not contract-call gas.
claims.errorVerbatim: Insufficient BASE balance. Have: 0.0, Need: 0.000000231. Fund 0x7ae891ec51990684682a084381e97b59d787652b with at least 0.000000231 BASE on this chain and retry.
claims.behaviourWhenBlocked: Simulate renders 'WOULD REVERT - NOT BROADCAST'. No cached receipt is replayed and no success is implied.
claims.correction: An earlier revision of this file said the gate was blocked on funding alone. It was also blocked on a defect: makeDemoPeople() reminted every demo signer on each page load, so no demo address was fundable - a faucet transfer would land on an address that ceased to exist at the next refresh. Fixed 2026-08-10 in apps/web/lib/demoKeys.ts (localStorage-pinned signers behind NEXT_PUBLIC_FINALTAB_PERSIST_DEMO_KEYS=1, ephemeral by default) and surfaced in apps/web/components/FundingPanel.tsx. Both branches verified in-browser: flag set gives byte-identical addresses across a reload, flag unset rotates them and writes nothing to storage.
claims.relayerFunding: Does not need a faucet. Measured against https://sepolia.base.org on 2026-08-10, the deployer 0x976EF25623A94F6F70924816697C7c7172210a5F holds 0x57e986e93ba4 (0.0000966605 ETH), roughly 418x what the relayer needs. contracts/scripts/fund-relayer.js sweeps it across but has not been run: it requires the deployer key, and using a wallet key is outside autonomous scope.
claims.unblockedBy: Two human actions: claim Base Sepolia USDC from Circle's login-gated faucet into the now-stable demo addresses, and run contracts/scripts/fund-relayer.js with the deployer key. Both outside autonomous scope.

claims.claim: Receipt extraction and natural-language allocation work against a live model
claims.value: Real requests through the app's own /api/vision/extract and allocation routes
claims.method: Live browser testing against the running app

claims.claim: The model cascade falls Groq -> Claude -> OpenAI
claims.value: 12 cascade tests driving the real router with each SDK mocked at the module boundary
claims.caveat: Only the Groq leg has ever contacted a real API. No Claude or OpenAI key is configured, so those two legs are tested, not proven. The OpenAI leg previously requested 'gpt-4-vision', which is not a served model id; it now requests 'gpt-4o' via OPENAI_VISION_MODEL. That correction is reasoned, not measured, because the leg still has no key.

claims.claim: Blurry or unusable receipt photos are rejected before they waste a model call
claims.value: A pristine fixture scored 62.7 against a threshold of 100 under the old metric - a false positive that rejected good images. The canonical metric scores the same fixture 4149.8.
claims.method: Fixed, then re-verified live in the browser

claims.claim: Debtors produce valid EIP-3009 receiveWithAuthorization signatures
claims.value: Sign button exercised in a real browser session against the running app; produces valid signatures
claims.caveat: Demo keys only. A prior revision of the docs called this a silent-failure blocker; live testing disproved that.

claims.claim: Demo debtor addresses can be made stable across reloads so a funded testnet address survives
claims.value: With NEXT_PUBLIC_FINALTAB_PERSIST_DEMO_KEYS=1 the three demo addresses are byte-identical across a browser reload; with the flag unset they rotate on every load and nothing is written to localStorage. Both branches exercised in a real browser session against the running dev server.
claims.implementation: apps/web/lib/demoKeys.ts (localStorage key finaltab.demo-signers.v1), surfaced by apps/web/components/FundingPanel.tsx
claims.tests: 46 unit tests in apps/web/test/demoKeys.test.ts, including a source-level regression guard that the flag is read as the literal process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FINALTAB_PERSIST_DEMO_KEYS member expression, because Next.js substitutes public env vars by matching that exact text and a unit test cannot observe bundler output.
claims.caveat: Persistence writes throwaway private keys to localStorage in plaintext. Off by default, opt-in, labelled in the UI, and only ever acceptable for disposable Base Sepolia identities. It does not itself unblock settle.onchain - it only makes the addresses fundable.

claims.claim: A real wallet can sign the settlement
claims.caveat: The MetaMask eth_signTypedData_v4 path is stubbed and has never been exercised end to end.

claims.claim: Settlement requires two explicit typed signatures per debtor
claims.value: FINALTab plan consent plus the USDC receiveWithAuthorization signature. The UI does not claim single-signature settlement.
claims.caveat: Verified in the demo-key flow, not against a real wallet.

claims.claim: All money is integer minor units; sum(shares) == total and sum(net) == 0
claims.value: 52 engine tests; live Groq proposals reconciled cent-perfect
claims.caveat: USD -> USDC scaling is x10^4 and applies to USD ledgers only. Non-USD ledgers render 'SPLIT ONLY - NOT SETTLEABLE ONCHAIN' rather than being mapped 1:1 to USDC.

claims.claim: A stated split rule is followed exactly
claims.gap: Extras are always prorated proportionally regardless of the rule the user states. This is disclosed in the UI. It is a real capability gap, not a rendering issue.
claims.caveat: Listed here rather than omitted because omitting it would make the allocation claim broader than its evidence.

claims.claim: A failed API call renders an honest error instead of crashing
claims.value: An untyped await res.json() flowed into string-typed state and React threw 'Objects are not valid as a React child', white-screening the app on the Simulate path. 11 call sites now route through apps/web/lib/apiText.ts, locked by 20 tests.
claims.method: Reproduced in the browser, fixed, re-verified in the browser

claims.claim: Sessions and history persist
claims.caveat: Schema is written. No credentials exist, the schema has never been applied, and nothing is persisted. The app is stateless per session. Docs previously listed this as a working feature; that was wrong and has been corrected.

claims.claim: A demo video exists, recorded against the real app
claims.caveat: Re-recorded 2026-08-10 in one continuous session against the running app. Includes a LIVE KeeperHub settlement executing on camera through to the VERIFIED SETTLED banner with the raw status JSON on screen (tx 0xac6d32e513ca3840b57d5211e40ff1be6ba8ecea2270bebb0b6ccd6a2e7c8710, block 45312815, executionId dbukwam812iep68uehkhy). NOT uploaded - upload is outside autonomous scope. Earlier docs specified a 2:20-2:40 target; the actual master is 1:42 and the docs now say so.

claims.claim: Visual proof stills exist
claims.blocker: The browser screenshot capability failed for this whole session: 'Screenshot timed out after 5s: the Browser pane is not displayed'. No still was ever captured, and none is claimed.

claims.claim: A KeeperHub CLI onboarding contribution was submitted upstream

claims.method: GET https://api.github.com/repos/KeeperHub/cli/pulls/95 and /files, queried 2026-08-10. The 7-test figure is a count of top-level Go Test funcs added in cmd/execute/status_verified_test.go (+246/-0), not an estimate.
claims.caveat: Open and under review. NOT merged, and it is not described as merged anywhere in this repo. Merge is the upstream maintainers' decision and is outside this project's control.
claims.correction: An earlier pass of this file marked this claim BLOCKED and asserted the PR URL 'was never real'. That assertion was itself wrong - it was written without querying GitHub. The PR exists and has existed since 2026-08-09. The original citation was accurate and is restored.

claims.claim: No secrets are live in the working tree
claims.value: A deployer private key was committed across six judge-facing docs and an Alchemy API key across four files. Both are redacted in the working tree; hardhat.config.js is now env-driven via BASE_SEPOLIA_RPC_URL with a public fallback.
claims.residualRisk: Local only, and narrower than this file previously stated. Corrected 2026-08-10: an earlier revision said both keys 'remain in git history at commit 1f20560'. That was measured and found false - git show 1f20560:SUBMISSION.md returns no key, and its only 64-hex token is the public Basescan tx hash. Both credentials do survive on this machine, but exclusively in unreachable objects.
claims.historyScan: Walked the entire object database rather than the commit graph: 190 blobs total (git cat-file --batch-all-objects), 305 objects reachable from all refs (git rev-list --objects --all), 38 unreachable (git fsck --unreachable --dangling). The deployer key appears in 8 blobs, every one unreachable. The Alchemy key appears only in unreachable blobs, inside base-sepolia.g.alchemy.com/v2/<key> URLs. Reachable objects containing either key: 0. Service-key shapes (gsk_, alcht_, xai-, nvapi-, sk-proj-, sk-ant-) across all 190 blobs: 0 matches.
claims.exposure: Git transfers only objects reachable from the refs being sent, so no clone, fetch, or push of github.com/vaibhav4046/finaltab can recover either credential. The deployer key is genuine - a local one-way key-to-address derivation (no signing, no broadcast) resolves it to 0x976EF25623A94F6F70924816697C7c7172210a5F, matching the documented deployer - and its blast radius is testnet dust with zero authority over the deployed contract.
claims.remediation: git reflog expire --expire-unreachable=now --all && git gc --prune=now. This touches no commit and changes no hash, so filter-repo is both unnecessary and the wrong tool. Rotating the Alchemy key remains worthwhile and is a user action. Neither was performed here.
claims.caveat: No secret value, prefix, or length is printed anywhere in this repo's documentation.

outOfScope: Rotating credentials or rewriting git history
